phaseName: Core Apps II: System Settings, Calendar, Photos, Music
goal: Implement four richer core apps: System Settings (mutates shared desktop state), Calendar (month nav + CRUD events persisted), Photos (IndexedDB grid), Music (Web Audio playback).
summary: Phase 5 complete: System Settings, Calendar, Photos, Music apps fully built with unit + E2E tests. Step 1 (System Settings): AppFrame with 5 panes (Appearance theme cards + brightness slider, Wallpaper grid of 5 presets, Network Wi-Fi/Bluetooth toggles, Sound info, General system info). Mutates desktopStore (theme flips [data-theme] on html, wallpaper sets --wallpaper CSS var, brightness/wifi/bluetooth persisted). 7 E2E tests incl. theme persists after reload. Step 2 (Calendar): useCalendarEvents hook with localStorage CRUD (addEvent/updateEvent/deleteEvent, 3-event seed, corrupt-JSON fallback). Month grid with prev/next nav, Today button, day cells with event dots, sidebar with event list + EventForm (title/time/notes). 8 unit tests. Step 3 (Photos): photosStore with IndexedDB (openDB, seedIfEmpty with 12 SVG-generated gradient images, getAllPhotos, getPhoto, deletePhoto, clearAllPhotos). Grid view + photo viewer with back/delete. 5 E2E tests incl. persist after reload. Step 4 (Music): musicEngine with MusicPlayer class (Web Audio synthesis — 4 tracks generated from oscillator note sequences, play/pause/next/prev/selectTrack/dispose, state+track callbacks, singleton). Music UI with now-playing (album art, progress bar, controls) + queue list. 18 unit tests with mocked AudioContext. Verification: `npx vitest run` → 126 passed; `npx playwright test` → 71 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (67 modules).
